values: Create follow-up tasks for external attendees
One task per external attendee based on NEXT STEPS
Send personalized follow-up email to each external attendee
Include their specific action items from NEXT STEPS
Include meeting reference ID in all follow-up communications
Add the Zoom meeting ID to email subject or body for tracking

fields.summary:
Discussion about Horizon Dynamics' needs for enterprise software.

KEY POINTS:
- Current pain points with legacy system
- Budget available Q2
- Decision timeline: 60 days

NEXT STEPS:
- Sarah mentioned she would get us pricing details by end of week
- Kevin offered to share their technical architecture for review
- We should set up a demo internally
- Lisa (our contractor) will update the CRM notes
